# JangaFX

> > JangaFX develops real-time VFX software including EmberGen, LiquiGen, IlluGen, and GeoGen for game development and visual effects production.

JangaFX specializes in GPU-accelerated, node-based tools for creating fire, smoke, explosions, liquids, procedural assets, and terrain in real-time. The Elemental Suite bundles EmberGen, LiquiGen, and IlluGen with VDB export capabilities for integration into industry-standard pipelines.

## Key Topics

- EmberGen - Real-time fire and smoke simulation
- LiquiGen - Real-time liquid simulation
- IlluGen - Procedural VFX and flipbook generation
- GeoGen - Real-time terrain and planet creation
- Elemental Suite - Bundled VFX software package
- VDB - OpenVDB format for volumetric data export
- Real-time VFX - GPU-accelerated visual effects
- Node-based workflow - Visual programming interface
- Game development tools - Assets for game engines
- Marketplace presets - Ready-made VFX assets
- Free trials - 14-day evaluation period
- Rent-to-own licensing - Flexible payment options
- GameTextureViewer (GTV) - Texture management tool

- [Try the Elemental Suite FOR FREE!](https://jangafx.com/software/elemental-suite/try): 14-day free trial for Elemental Suite VFX software (EmberGen/LiquiGen/IlluGen)

- [GeoGen: Realtime terrain creation tool](https://jangafx.com/software/geogen/try): GeoGen free trial: real-time terrain and planet creation tool
- [IlluGen: Procedural Real-time Asset Generation](https://jangafx.com/software/illugen/try): IlluGen free trial: procedural VFX and flipbook generation tool
- [GameTextureViewer: Easy to use resource manager](https://jangafx.com/software/gametextureviewer): GameTextureViewer (GTV): GPU-accelerated texture browsing and management tool
